# Scrutexity - AI Search Index
Scrutexity provides missed-demand recovery software for medical aesthetics clinics, with a BAA executed before patient-adjacent workflows are activated.
We specialize in High-Ticket Consultation Recovery and AI Search Visibility.

## Core Modules
1. Port 01: AI Reactivation Twin - Recovers high-ticket consultation dropoffs within 12 hours.
2. Port 02: Morpheus8 Estimator - Treatment-specific booking funnel with dynamic pricing logic.
3. Port 04: AI Search Schema Injector - Engineered for first-card citation in Perplexity, ChatGPT, and Siri.
4. Port 05: FTC Compliance Airlock - Server-side proxy that strips PHI from tracker cookies.

## Compliance
- All modules require a Business Associate Agreement (BAA).
- Zero data leakage, full BAA execution, and end-to-end SHA-256 encryption.

To run a free clinic diagnostic or apply for a 14-day zero-risk pilot, visit https://scrutexity.com
